notes.title: Steam Achievements for Dead Simple 21
notes.content:
We've just added Steam Achievements to Dead Simple 21!

There's 23 achievements for you to try and complete. Some simple, some difficult and some that will get you thinking (what is [b]Ghost Bustin'[/b] ?)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35802402/2ffd278b1b3d8c66d7c8ae28460a1daea79af843.png[/img]

- enjoy!
